limitations: Only nvidia-smi,/proc metadata,filesystem/stat and kernel /proc/locks reads; no GPU context, lock acquisition, signals, dispatch, policy or owner change.
No visible kernel lock is an observation, not proof a lease is free across every PID/mount namespace. Worker must recheck UUIDs/actual owners and acquire its exact lease at dispatch.
Snapshot is time bounded; actual admission must be repeated by existing worker. Unknown allocations/PIDs are never interpreted as pressure jobs or killed.
D46 official evaluator remains formal_v1 tools.d44_native_rl.evaluate; baseline/world/seed/scorer and checkpoints are unchanged.
